# NdIndex Trait Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Define the sealed `NdIndex<D>` trait, provide tuple and slice-based index implementations for ranks 0-6, and establish the checked F-order offset helper used by all Wave 20 access APIs.

**Architecture:** `src/index/mod.rs` declares the indexing module, `src/index/ndindex.rs` owns the sealed `NdIndex<D>` abstraction plus checked/unchecked F-order offset logic, and temporary stubs for `src/index/access.rs` and `src/index/slice.rs` keep the module tree valid until later Wave 20 tasks fill those files.

**Tech Stack:** Rust, `Dimension`, `Ix0`-`Ix6`, `Strides<D>`, `Vec<usize>`, sealed traits

**Design Docs:** `design/17-indexing.md` §5.1 (trait and descriptor design), §6.1-§6.2 (offset calculation), §8.2 (tests), §10 (error model)

**Prerequisites:** W8T1 (`TensorBase<S, D>`) and W3T1 (`Dimension`) must be complete.

- [ ] **Step 1: Add real failing tests for checked and unchecked indexing**

Append this test module to `src/index/ndindex.rs`:

```rust
#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use crate::dimension::{Ix2, Ix3};
    use crate::layout::Strides;

    use super::{compute_offset_f, NdIndex};

    #[test]
    fn test_try_at_2d() {
        let dim = Ix2(3, 4);
        let strides = Strides::new(Ix2(1, 3));

        assert_eq!((2, 1).index_checked(&dim, &strides), Some(5));
        assert_eq!((0, 3).index_checked(&dim, &strides), Some(9));
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_try_at_out_of_bounds() {
        let dim = Ix2(3, 4);
        let strides = Strides::new(Ix2(1, 3));

        assert_eq!((3, 1).index_checked(&dim, &strides), None);
        assert_eq!((2, 4).index_checked(&dim, &strides), None);
        assert_eq!((&[1, 2, 3][..]).index_checked(&dim, &strides), None);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_checked_offset_matches_unchecked_offset() {
        let dim = Ix3(2, 3, 4);
        let strides = Strides::new(Ix3(1, 2, 6));
        let index = (1, 2, 3);

        let checked = index.index_checked(&dim, &strides);
        let unchecked = unsafe { index.index_unchecked(&strides) };

        assert_eq!(checked, Some(23));
        assert_eq!(checked, Some(unchecked));
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_tuple_and_slice_index_parity() {
        let dim = Ix2(3, 4);
        let strides = Strides::new(Ix2(1, 3));
        let tuple = (1, 2);
        let slice = &[1, 2][..];

        assert_eq!(tuple.to_index_vec(), vec![1, 2]);
        assert_eq!(slice.to_index_vec(), vec![1, 2]);
        assert_eq!(tuple.index_checked(&dim, &strides), slice.index_checked(&dim, &strides));
        assert_eq!(compute_offset_f(&tuple.to_index_vec(), &strides), Some(7));
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Write the complete sealed trait, helpers, and impl matrix**

Write `src/index/ndindex.rs` with the following content:

```rust
use crate::dimension::{Dimension, Ix0, Ix1, Ix2, Ix3, Ix4, Ix5, Ix6};
use crate::layout::Strides;
use crate::private::Sealed;

pub trait NdIndex<D: Dimension>: Sealed {
    fn index_checked(&self, dim: &D, strides: &Strides<D>) -> Option<usize>;

    /// Converts this index into the canonical error-reporting form.
    fn to_index_vec(&self) -> Vec<usize>;

    /// # Safety
    ///
    /// The caller must ensure that:
    /// - the index rank matches the tensor rank
    /// - each index component is within bounds for the corresponding axis
    /// - the resulting offset does not overflow `usize`
    unsafe fn index_unchecked(&self, strides: &Strides<D>) -> usize;
}

fn compute_offset_f<D: Dimension>(index: &[usize], strides: &Strides<D>) -> Option<usize> {
    let mut offset = 0usize;
    for (&idx, &stride) in index.iter().zip(strides.iter()) {
        let term = idx.checked_mul(stride)?;
        offset = offset.checked_add(term)?;
    }
    Some(offset)
}

fn index_checked_impl<D: Dimension>(index: &[usize], dim: &D, strides: &Strides<D>) -> Option<usize> {
    if index.len() != dim.ndim() {
        return None;
    }

    for (&idx, &axis_len) in index.iter().zip(dim.slice().iter()) {
        if idx >= axis_len {
            return None;
        }
    }

    compute_offset_f(index, strides)
}

unsafe fn index_unchecked_impl<D: Dimension>(index: &[usize], strides: &Strides<D>) -> usize {
    compute_offset_f(index, strides).expect("validated NdIndex must produce a valid offset")
}

impl Sealed for () {}

impl NdIndex<Ix0> for () {
    fn index_checked(&self, dim: &Ix0, strides: &Strides<Ix0>) -> Option<usize> {
        let index: [usize; 0] = [];
        index_checked_impl(&index, dim, strides)
    }

    fn to_index_vec(&self) -> Vec<usize> {
        Vec::new()
    }

    unsafe fn index_unchecked(&self, strides: &Strides<Ix0>) -> usize {
        let index: [usize; 0] = [];
        unsafe { index_unchecked_impl(&index, strides) }
    }
}

macro_rules! impl_ndindex_tuple {
    ($dim:ty, $tuple:ty, [$($field:tt),+]) => {
        impl Sealed for $tuple {}

        impl NdIndex<$dim> for $tuple {
            fn index_checked(&self, dim: &$dim, strides: &Strides<$dim>) -> Option<usize> {
                let index = [$(self.$field),+];
                index_checked_impl(&index, dim, strides)
            }

            fn to_index_vec(&self) -> Vec<usize> {
                vec![$(self.$field),+]
            }

            unsafe fn index_unchecked(&self, strides: &Strides<$dim>) -> usize {
                let index = [$(self.$field),+];
                unsafe { index_unchecked_impl(&index, strides) }
            }
        }
    };
}

impl_ndindex_tuple!(Ix1, (usize,), [0]);
impl_ndindex_tuple!(Ix2, (usize, usize), [0, 1]);
impl_ndindex_tuple!(Ix3, (usize, usize, usize), [0, 1, 2]);
impl_ndindex_tuple!(Ix4, (usize, usize, usize, usize), [0, 1, 2, 3]);
impl_ndindex_tuple!(Ix5, (usize, usize, usize, usize, usize), [0, 1, 2, 3, 4]);
impl_ndindex_tuple!(Ix6, (usize, usize, usize, usize, usize, usize), [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]);

impl Sealed for &[usize] {}

impl<D: Dimension> NdIndex<D> for &[usize] {
    fn index_checked(&self, dim: &D, strides: &Strides<D>) -> Option<usize> {
        index_checked_impl(self, dim, strides)
    }

    fn to_index_vec(&self) -> Vec<usize> {
        self.to_vec()
    }

    unsafe fn index_unchecked(&self, strides: &Strides<D>) -> usize {
        unsafe { index_unchecked_impl(self, strides) }
    }
}
```
